author: bardic-inspiration
name: Ruinous Beam
summary: A beam of destructive energy that burns through armor and flesh.

stats.effect: A 5-foot-wide, 120-foot Line of searing light erupts from you. Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d8 Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much on a success. A creature in the line has its armor class reduced by 2 until the end of your next turn.
